Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains both proteome-wide LFQ and AP-MS interactome analyses. The PRIDE metadata specifically focuses on the interactome (AP-MS). Acquisition is DDA based on the use of Q-Exactive HF and Mascot search parameters typical for DDA.

scope: Toxoplasma extracts from RH∆ku80 or Pru∆ku80 cells stably expressing HA–Flag-tagged AP2XII-1 or AP2XI-2 proteins, respectively, were incubated with anti-Flag M2 affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich) for 1 h at 4 °C.
Bound polypeptides were eluted stepwise with 250 μg ml−1 Flag peptide (Sigma-Aldrich) diluted in BC100 buffer.

T. gondii extracts from RH∆ku80 cells stably expressing HAFlag-tagged AP2 XII-1 or AP2 XI-2 proteins or none (Mock = negative control) were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich) for 1 hour at 4°C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The PRIDE metadata and the 'Chromatographic purification of Flag-tagged proteins' section explicitly describe the use of anti-Flag M2 affinity gel to capture AP2 interactomes, which were then analyzed by MS. While the paper also mentions proteome-wide analyses of lysates, the specific PRIDE accession PXD042658 is titled 'Mass spectrometry-based proteomic characterization of T. gondii AP2XI-2 and AP2XII-1 interactomes' and describes affinity purification.
